connector.name: Icd10 Coding
connector.registryDescription: ICD-10-CM / HCC medical coding tools with database-verified accuracy and denial-prevention rules.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.accurecord.io over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace io.accurecord, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: API key from https://accurecord.io (free tier available; Pro/Enterprise for AI coding).
